title: LADM LA_BAUnit
description: Basic Administrative Unit — the administrative counterpart of the spatial unit. A BAUnit groups the spatial units that define one person's rights or the spatial extent of a restriction/responsibility, and links them to the applicable RRRs. LA_BAUnit is not a spatial feature; it has no geometry.

id.description: Globally unique identifier (UUID or URI), OGC API compatible

name.description: Name or code of the basic administrative unit

type.description: LA_BAUnitType codelist. Common values: basicPropertyUnit, legalSpaceNetwork, legalSpaceBuilding.

creationDate.description: Date this BAUnit was legally created

terminationDate.description: Date this BAUnit was legally terminated (null if still active)

su.description: Typed references to the LA_SpatialUnit(s) that define the spatial extent of this BAUnit [1..*]

rrr.description: References to the LA_RRR instances (rights, restrictions, responsibilities) applicable to this BAUnit [0..*]. May be URI links or embedded objects discriminated by rrrType.
